successors.name: Âu Lạc
successors.text: 'geographically covering most of modern Northern Vietnam', the land of the Lạc Việt, capital at Phong Châu in Phú Thọ

ledger.x: Dong Son bronze age: the Lac Viet of the Red River.

c. 258 BCE: Thục Phán ends Văn Lang. 'Văn Lang ended c. 258 BC when the Âu invaded under their Shu prince Thục Phán'; 'Thục defeated the last Hùng Vương, united the kingdoms as Âu Lạc, and proclaimed himself An Dương Vương.' The au-lac dossier dates the founding 257 BCE.

wars.name: Thục Phán's conquest of Văn Lang
wars.outcome: The Âu Việt under Thục Phán defeat the last Hùng king and unite the two kingdoms as Âu Lạc.

certainty.note: Traditional history on one page; four borders are named as seas, a lake and kingdoms, not surveyed.
